message: Validation field "visibility" on Workbench\App\Http\Requests\StoreNoticeRequest states values this build cannot read, so that constraint is left off the request schema; the rest of its rules are documented.
help: A value the rule states is not written at the rule — it comes from a call, a variable or a spread — and a partial list would make a client reject a value the API accepts.
